title: Push reader
description: An agent on the server reads each push to a repository connected through the GitHub App against its open work, and re-checks a repository's oldest open items against its code: on the workspace's model account, held to the one repository, what it changes waiting for the owner unless they asked for it.

actions.title: Re-check its oldest items now
actions.description: Have the agent on the server re-check a repository's oldest open items against its code now, without waiting for one to be due. It runs on the workspace's model account, and its run shows on the repository's page when it is over. Only for a repository the GitHub App was given; admins only.
